description: This file defines a PHP class 'TestRunCommands' within the SuiteCRM project, extending Robo tasks to implement various test suite execution commands for install, API, acceptance, and unit tests. It includes methods to run each test suite with configurable options like debug and fail-fast.

classes.name: TestRunCommands
classes.description: A Robo command class providing methods to run different test suites with customizable options.

methods.name: TestsInstall
methods.description: Runs the install test suite with optional debug and fail-fast modes.

methods.name: TestsAPI
methods.description: Runs the API test suite with optional debug and fail-fast modes.

methods.name: TestsAcceptance
methods.description: Runs the acceptance test suite with optional debug and fail-fast modes.

methods.name: TestsUnit
methods.description: Runs the PHPUnit unit test suite with optional debug, fail-fast, and filter options.
